$comment: Grounded retrieval + entailment latency budget (audit KEIKO-0053). Enforced by scripts/check-grounded-retrieval-latency.mjs (`npm run check:grounded-retrieval-latency`), which times keiko-server's runGroundedRetrievalLatencyEval: the REAL semantic + RRF + model-rerank path over the quality gate's distractor-dense corpus, followed by the REAL citation-reconciliation and claim-entailment pass. Both provider ports and the entailment judge are deterministic stubs, so the gate measures CODE-PATH cost and never model-serving variance. The budgets are generous p50/p95 CEILINGS (roughly 11x and 21x the locally observed values below) so they catch algorithmic regressions without flaking on CI machine class; they are NOT a target, and they are deliberately unrelated to DEFAULT_ENTAILMENT_OPTIONS.maxTotalMs (20000), which is a per-request safety ceiling rather than a performance goal. Methodology: warmupIterations discarded, then `iterations` timed runs; both percentiles must stay <= their budget. regressionProbe then adds judgeDelayMs to every bounded-parallel judge call in one extra sample; the delay interval itself MUST breach p95BudgetMs because parallel delays do not add — a gate that cannot fail proves nothing.

regressionProbe.$comment: The eight cited claims run in bounded parallel. A 1300ms interval clears the 800ms p95 ceiling by more than 1.5x, so detection does not depend on machine speed or serial execution.

observed.$comment: Local darwin/arm64, 16 logical cores. Informational provenance only; the gate compares against the budgets above.
